recipe.protocol: Sluka et al. 2016, Fig 4 (venous APAP, REFSIM), venous APAP after a 1.4 g oral dose (APAP_sim line) (digitized from the figure with scripts/digitize_figure_panels.py (dark-line trace; axis labels read by eye); 1566 points, its own interpolation spending 41% of the pass budget); read in ug/mL and converted to mol/L by x6.61376e-06 (ug/mL is mg/L; divided by the model's own APAP_MW of 151.2 g/mol and by 1000 mg/g)
